### bld
ONLY: `dependencyGraph` required on AnalysisResult in types.ts; fix compile fallout (remove unnecessary optional chaining where invariant holds).

### bru

### 8pt
ONLY: (1) `kind: 'stepdown'|'nested'` discriminant + fix guards; (2) non-mutating findAndRemoveLeafFunctions; (3) position map composite key. Prefer not exporting DFS internals unless required.

### 5x2.2

The type { node: ts.Node; info: null } appears 6+ times across fixer.ts, ast-node-visitors.ts, and ast-graph-builder.ts. <think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Stepdown-8pt begins with adding a `kind` discriminator to violation types.

Next steps include updating all violation constructions and fixing the `isStepdownViolation` and nested filters to use the new `kind` field. `findAndRemoveLeafFunctions` will become non-mutating by returning a tuple of leaf names and remaining dependencies. The position map composite key also needs correction.

The position map composite key must pair the original index with the trimmed line. Otherwise, the fixed-side lookup cannot match the same function across different positions.

Identical trimmed signatures overwrite the position map. A better approach is to build an array of {trimmed, index} pairs for original signatures instead of a flat map.

The position map will store ordered indices per trimmed signature. `countFunctionMovements` will track each occurrence with a running counter to detect reordering without colliding entries.

The occurrence-counter approach was rejected because the acceptance criteria explicitly require a line-plus-index composite key. The position map will instead use a composite key built as `${index}:${trimmed}`.
